nom: ma:nyo Deep Pore Cleansing Soda Foam

avis.texte: A great deep cleansing face wash. My new favorite K beauty brand.

It does do the job of exfoliating your skin; however it burns. I noticed at first it burning my eyes after rinsing it off, but then I got a big red raw patch of skin on my chin and upper lip that also caused alot of irritated bumps to appear. Im now having to repair my skin. I really enjoy their oil balm cleanser, but not this product.

avis.titre: Great for oily and feeling clean
avis.texte: I bought this on sale and so glad I did! there are times when my face feels extremely oily and this makes it feel clean after, instantly. My husband, who rarely ever touches anything skincare, stole it from me! It is THAT good. I have less bumps and clogged pores, but not 100% gone, however I've been using it for about 3 months.

Saw this product on sale and been loving korean skin products. I love anything wirh green tea in it so had to try it. It cleaned my pores out well since beibg hormonal postpartum. Love how my skin feels after. Will be getting again in the future and adding to every 3 day routine since it can be drying.

This is the only cleanser that i notice a difference after using it. The next day i notice my acne shrinking and not getting the tiny acne around my temples. Consistency is key! I use it in the morning and night. Leaves my face feeling squicky clean but not over drying
my sensitive skin didnt agree. i like how well it lathered but my skin is so dry after use and it burns.
After years if trying to get rid of sebaceous filamants on my nose, this did the trick in just two weeks! After the first use i noticed a difference, and now my skin has never been clearer

avis.titre: No I won't buy it again
avis.texte: It makes mine skin super dry I wouldn't recommend it if u have dry skin !
I love using this cleanser. It has a nice, relaxing scent. It lathers really well and my skin feels so clean after.

These face cleansing product is amazing. Gentle but super effective at breaking down the oil that accumulates in face pores. I was surprised that such a small amount does the job - about a dime size dollop, it foams and it's nice and silky, will not irritate the skin, If you have issued with clogged pores, just make sure you leave it on your skin for a few minutes so it can be more effective at dissolving and breaking down the build up that accumulates inside facial pores.

avis.titre: A little goes a long way!
avis.texte: This cleanser is crazy good! I have been using this cleanser for about a month now and I love it! I use it twice a week for gentle exfoliation. The smallest amount foams up like crazy, so you don't need much product. What I also love is the size of the bottle for the price. You are getting a lot of product for not a lot of $$. This cleanses my pores deep and leaves my face nice and smooth afterwards. It also has a gentle pleasant smell to it, but it doesn't irritate my skin (I have sensitive skin). I will continue to buy this, it exceeded my expectations!

I really liked this soda-based facial peeling! It cleanses the skin effectively without causing any damage or dryness. After use, my face feels fresh and clean. I especially appreciate how it penetrates deep into the pores and removes any leftover makeup. My skin feels soft, smooth, and noticeably more refined. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: BUY (if you have combination to oily skin)
avis.texte: I have combination skin that tends to be more oily in the summer and I suffer from hormonal acne and large pores. This product is a complete game changer!! Makes skin feel very tight and youthful after cleansing. And pores? Practically gone. HOWEVER, please make sure to use a good/hydrating moisturizer after cleansing because it can be drying if not used properly.

This stuff smells so good and makes my skin soft as ever. I love it. I'll never use anything else. I have perorial dermatitis and allergies and this didn't break me out it actually helped my breakouts. 10/10

This is a great deep pore cleanser and not drying. Expect your skin to look worse before it gets better as it dissolves the sebum. I have been using this for 3 weeks now and my pores are much smaller and skin is soft. It foams so much after using a pea sized drop of it and you could feel your skin feeling clean after rinsing your face with water.
This has become my favorite water basex cleanser. It has a unqiue smell and cleanses well and I havent had any break outs using this. Its been about two months and in very pleased!

I love this cleanser! Ive been using it for about a month now and it is definitely my new favorite! A little goes a long way which is great. My skin feels so clean and refreshed after using it. The lather it creates feels so nice and luxurious on my skin. My pores have never looked better!

The Deep Pore Cleansing Soda Foam is amazing! The foam feels light but still manages to get deep into my pores, especially around my T-zone where I tend to get oily. I love how refreshed my skin feels after using it, and it hasn't caused any irritation or dryness. Plus, I've noticed my blackheads are starting to clear up, which is a huge win. Definitely worth trying if you want a good daily cleanser that really works!

I recently tried a cleansing foam that features soda as a key ingredient, and I'm impressed! The soda creates a gentle, bubbly lather that deeply cleanses my skin without stripping it of moisture. It feels refreshing and invigorating, leaving my skin feeling smooth, soft, and thoroughly clean. Even with my sensitive skin, I haven't experienced any irritation. It's great for those days when my skin needs a little extra purifying. If you're looking for a cleansing foam that offers a deep clean with a refreshing twist, this one is worth trying!

This cleanser was way too harsh for me. I have sensitive, acne prone, dry-combo skin. I tried it for a couple of days and could not handle it, it burned every time and it hurt to follow up with anything afterwards, even just moisturizer. It caused lots of inflammed acne to pop up.
